step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features a user device accessing AWS services through Route 53. Route 53 routes requests either directly to CloudFront or through ELB to an EKS cluster. EKS interacts with both RDS and ElastiCache. For the data lake pipeline, Glue pulls data from RDS, outputs to S3, and S3 loads data into Redshift.

edges.notes: Route 53 directs static content requests to CloudFront
Route 53 directs application requests to ELB
ELB forwards requests to EKS cluster
EKS microservices query/write to RDS databases
EKS microservices load cached data from ElastiCache
AWS Glue connects to RDS to extract database records
AWS Glue loads extracted data into S3 data lake
Data is loaded from S3 into Amazon Redshift for analytics
